selection: Every record is decoded and gated by tools/car_roster.py; the five below are the ones
this slice drives. The selection keeps the T-007 baseline (regression anchor) and adds one
car per drivetrain (RWD light / RWD heavy / FWD / AWD) so the same scripted drive produces
different, explainable physics on the same spawn, script and collision mesh.

cars.name: Corvette_ZR1_Stock
cars.why: the T-005d/T-007 baseline car; kept first so the existing single-car slice stays a regression anchor

cars.name: Lotus_ExigeCup260_Stock
cars.why: lightest car in the roster: 890 kg on the same tyres should out-accelerate and out-brake the Corvette

cars.name: Dodge_Challenger_Stock
cars.why: heaviest road car with a long wheelbase (2.981 m): inertially the opposite end from the Lotus

cars.name: Ford_FocusRS_Stock
cars.why: driveType 1 (front wheel) exercises the transmission path the RWD baseline never touches

cars.name: Audi_R8V10_Stock
cars.why: driveType 2 (four wheel) with the front differential torques populated: the third drivetrain branch
